tasks.prompt:
Add a priority feature to the task tracker, split across two levels. (1) In src/model/task.ts add type Priority = "low" | "normal" | "high", add a priority field to the Task interface, add parsePriority(s: string): Priority that throws on anything other than the three values, and change createTask to accept an optional priority argument defaulting to "normal". In src/store/store.ts, a stored task loaded without a priority field loads as "normal". Add or extend tests in tests/model.test.ts and tests/store.test.ts. (2) In src/commands/add.ts accept a --priority

flag as the first argument (before the title, when present); a bad value is code 1 with err naming the three allowed values (low, normal, high). In src/commands/list.ts accept a --priority

flag (also first, when present) that filters the list to that priority, printing '(no tasks)' when the filter matches none; with no filter, list orders tasks by priority (high, normal, low), then by id within a priority. In src/format.ts, formatTask appends ' (high)' or ' (low)' after the title; normal shows no marker. Extend tests/cli.test.ts for both commands. When .doug/plan.json exists it carries the approved plan for this change: two tasks in two levels. Run the tests and the typecheck to confirm.
